TotalHours.description: TotalHours is the team stand time (event and moderators teams).

Why.description: Why says why the agent is not used: disabled, below_requirements, no_capacity.

Stage.description: Stage is how far the escalation went (0 first sight, 1 a day before the deploy lead, 2 two hours before, 3 at the lead).

Size.description: Size is the laboratory's total (the exercise totals the catalog shows); LargestDevice its largest device.

Start.description: Start is the wanted start (aligned down to a 15-minute slot).

CurrentSize.description: Current is what the reservation holds now; the admin decides against it.

AllowConflicts.description: AllowConflicts keeps an approved change that no longer fits by packing (the reservation is then not covered).

BufferPercent.description: BufferPercent and Dynamic are part of Allocated: the buffer and the estimate for future dynamic tasks.

Covered.description: Covered: the reservation is placed in full. False means the platform admin has been alerted.

Reserved.description: Reserved is false when the event has no reservation (nothing else is set then).

Left.description: Left is the capacity the window leaves; zero unless the cluster operator named some.

To.description: To is null for a window without an end.

Covered.description: Covered: every team has an agent and no slot of the window is over capacity.

Used.description: Used is what the event's running objects request now.

Saved.description: Saved is false for a dry run.

AllowConflicts.description: AllowConflicts keeps a reservation that does not fit by packing (it is then not covered).

DryRun.description: DryRun only reports what would happen.

Dynamic.description: Dynamic is the estimate for tasks that appear later.

TailGapMinutes.description: TailGapMinutes is the gap after the event end; never shorter than the default (60), may be more.

WindowStart.description: WindowStart and WindowEnd override the window; WindowEnd is the event end (the gap is added).

AllowConflicts.description: AllowConflicts keeps a pool that the reservations of the next month no longer leave room for.

TestPool.description: TestPool is the guaranteed minimum for test laboratories: always on, never reserved by events.

NearestFrom.description: NearestFrom is the start of the nearest free window when not available (null: none within the horizon).

Via.description: Via says how it is admitted: booking, pool or free.

Maintenance.description:
Maintenance are the windows the cluster operators announced on the agents that are used which touch the range,
soonest first. In one the agent gives the platform no capacity (or Left).

MaintenanceReported.description:
MaintenanceReported is true when every agent that is used has reported its windows; false means some agent may
have windows the calendar does not know.

context.description:
Context is what the error marked public (err.WithPublicContext), e.g. nearest_from; omitted when none. Nothing
else of an error's context is ever sent.

ErrorKind.description:
ErrorKind and ErrorCode classify a failed email (dispatchModel.MailError*,
the SMTP reply code); empty when the text is not a transport error.

FallbackErrorKind.description: FallbackErrorKind and FallbackErrorCode classify FallbackError the same way.

Recipient.description:
Recipient is the address of an email target; an in-app target has none
of its own, so it shows the dispatch's recipient user. RecipientName is
that user's name when the target belongs to them.

Values.description:
Values are sample variable values; missing variables use the type's
defaults.

Entries.description: Entries: one line per person with its own role (empty = user).

Role.description: Role and Code are set for Entries: Code is empty on success.
